project: Build the Skill Tree App (Anti-Creep Engine)

nodes.title: LLM JSON Engine
nodes.instruction: Write a Python script that sends a hardcoded app concept to an LLM with strict instructions to return a parseable JSON skill tree with 3 Level-1 steps and 1 Level-2 step.

nodes.title: SVG Skill Canvas
nodes.instruction: Use react-native-svg to draw three static circles connected by lines on the skill tree canvas.

nodes.title: Node Lock State
nodes.instruction: Grey out the bottom circle and add a functional Tested & Working checkbox on the top circle that unlocks the child node.

nodes.title: Boss Fight Integration
nodes.instruction: Connect the LLM JSON output to the canvas: dynamically render parent and child nodes from fixture JSON; parent unlocks child when tested.
